reviews.title: Be careful what you subscribe for
reviews.text:
⚠️ Be very careful what you’re signing up for

This app is extremely misleading. I believed I was paying £5.99 for one week only, not agreeing to a weekly subscription of £5.99, which is outrageously expensive, especially when there are free authenticator apps available that do exactly the same thing.

Because the charge appears under Apple Services, I didn’t realise for a long time that money was being taken every single week, even though I have never used the app. By the time I noticed, a significant amount had already been taken from my account.

When I contacted Apple, I was told that they cannot refund me, or at best only partially, despite acknowledging how misleading these subscriptions are. Trying to speak to an actual human at Apple was incredibly frustrating and took half a day, just to be told to “be more careful next time” and that I could submit a complaint with no guarantee of any response.

£5.99 per week or £19.99 per year for something that is freely available elsewhere is unacceptable. This feels deliberately designed to confuse users, and unfortunately Apple enables it.

Please read everything very carefully before accepting any payment - these apps can quietly drain your money without you realising.
